Discover the secret to optimal health and wellness with the original pioneers of longevity. Stay with us and benefit from our 7-decades of groundbreaking expertise at our 55-acre Florida oasis.

Stay With Us https://vimeo.com/998661074/eae0ee5701?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci

The world-leading wellness retreat for optimal health and longevity

For nearly 70 years, Hippocrates Wellness in West Palm Beach, Florida, has treated a wide range of illnesses with a compassionate team led by Anna Maria and Brian Clement.

Our 55-acre retreat provides a clinically researched, sustainable lifestyle focused on reversing aging and disease through nutritional counseling, therapies, lectures, and organic cuisine.

Whether you're aiming to prevent or reverse health issues, Hippocrates Wellness offers an unparalleled environment for achieving optimal health and well-being.

Invest in your future health today!

Discover the perfect health journey for you

21 Days

Whether you want to reverse or prevent serious health conditions or reset, reboot, and rebalance your body, mind, and spirit, the globally renowned Hippocrates Wellness Life Transformation Program is the ultimate experience for transforming your mental and physical wellbeing at any stage of life.

Learn More 28 Days

Our Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program is based on a holistic approach to help you restore your metabolic health, up-regulate your immune system, and mobilize your vitality to accelerate healing and wellness. Hippocrates Wellness has a renowned international reputation for helping people from all over the world with cancer to restore their health.
